text_markup: The Runner uses the ability on {card:Security Nexus} during a reaction window at the beginning of the Encounter Ice Phase. The trace is successful, so the ability ends the run. If {card:Tollbooth}'s ability is also pending in this reaction window, it will not be resolved, since the encounter has ended.
